description: Re-scan every member of a saved cohort against the live decision engine to find each member's current best offer. Returns a triage list (label, best lender, best APR, monthly payment, optional savings vs current) and a diff vs the previous scan (who's new, whose best lender changed, APR deltas). Persists the new snapshot. Use this to refresh a book of business and surface what changed.
name: scan_portfolio

outputSchema.description: Live re-scan of every cohort member against the decision engine, diffed against the previous snapshot. The new snapshot is persisted.

changed.description: Members whose best offer moved since the previous scan.

apr_delta.description: Change in APR in percentage points.

from.description: Prior best_lender and best_apr. Absent for a new member.

monthly_payment.description: Monthly payment on the best offer.

savings_vs_current.description: Monthly saving against the member's stated current rate, when supplied.
